FFmpeg audio extension for OwnTV

Java audio renderer/decoder: AndroidX Media3 1.11.1, Apache License 2.0.
Source: https://github.com/androidx/media/tree/1.11.1/libraries/decoder_ffmpeg
Native binaries: org.jellyfin.media3:media3-ffmpeg-decoder:1.9.0+1, GPL-3.0.
Source/build project: https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-androidx-media
Source archive: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/jellyfin/media3/media3-ffmpeg-decoder/1.9.0+1/media3-ffmpeg-decoder-1.9.0+1-sources.jar
JNI signatures and the audio decode algorithm were compared against Media3 1.11.1.
Only the audio extension is included. Native libs support armv7, arm64, x86, x86_64
and have 16 KiB ELF LOAD alignment. File checksums: tools/ffmpeg/audio_manifest.json.
The original notices in the Java files are retained. OwnTV_Core is GPL-3.0.
